stores.name: Aesop
stores.description: Aesop offers skin, hair & body care formulations, and personal & home fragrances, created with meticulous attention to detail and sensory pleasure in mind. The alchemic beauty of a setting sun pervades Aesop Aventura in northern Miami, evoking memories of long, languid days in the Magic City. Lustrous finishes such as a glossy resin floor and velvet-backed shelves nod to the hedonism of the city, revealed once the sun finally sets, while a large branching column fabricated from folded raw copper mirrors the palm trees that line the nearby shore—over time, age and oxidation will grace it with a singularly patinated appearance. A Fragrance Library sits on the rear wall, displaying a range of characterful eaux de parfum, while a large basin lines the perimeter, offering customers the opportunity to experience skin, hair and body care formulations first-hand—and discuss those best suited to their individual needs with our trained consultants.
